lines.text: Many learners say: This is my friend car.
Better: This is my friend's car.
My brother's! This is my brother's bike.

native.tip: Dalam bahasa Indonesia “mobil teman saya” cukup disusun begitu saja. Bahasa Inggris tambah ’s pada pemilik: friend's car.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “This is my friend car.” 😅 Pemilik barang diberi ’s: “This is my friend's car.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “my brother's”. Tulis satu kalimat tentang barang temanmu dengan ’s. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: In Indonesian “mobil teman saya” works as it is. English adds ’s to the owner: friend's car.
en.caption: Ever say this? “This is my friend car.” 😅 Put ’s on the owner: “This is my friend's car.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
